role: Help Center data model: HelpCategory, HelpArticle (with flattened lowercase search text) and the ArticleSection enum of renderable blocks.
toplevel: Pure value types; no stored globals. ArticleSection.keyValue carries an array of labelled tuples, so ArticleSection is not Equatable/Codable.

units.does: Builds a lowercased string of title + summary + every section's plain text (via plainText) joined by spaces; HelpCenterView.searchResults (HelpCenterView.swift:25) filters articles with `.contains(query)` on it.

Returns the user-visible words of one ArticleSection for search: the string payload for text/heading/tip/warning/note, the joined items for bullets/steps, 'label value' pairs joined for keyValue, and '' for divider.

branches.effect: returns each 'label value' pair joined by spaces
